### chorus
| Emi mimo so fun mi pe maborio/2x ohun aye le gbona girigiri ki wahala opo/2x Emi mimo so fun mi pe mabo ri o.

### Verse 1
| Se wahala Nigeria lomi o lokan rogbodiyan aisonje at'ekun ojojumo oro-aje todo juru lomi olokan lofi pinu ninu okan wipe tire kole daramo mo ni royin ayo fun oo Emi so pon bo wada.

| Hymn: okan are Ile kan mbe....

| Ogun ota ni onfino bina t'obasun won leo tobaajo won ale o won o fio lokan bale won fe daye reru mase ronu mo mase bokanje Emi mimo ni kin wifuno pe Olorun lodao awon ko loda kiki k'ogbadura Emi so pon bowada. Chr
